Name: sp_ineachdb
Description: Prerequisite install only: sp_ineachdb.sql (First Responder Kit 8.34/20260702). sp_Blitz 8.34 hard-depends on dbo.sp_ineachdb, which replaced sp_MSforeachdb upstream. No EXEC and no output query: DiagnosticScriptRunner installs the batches, then stops. ExecutionOrder 0 puts it ahead of sp_Blitz (1), and FullAudit runs the selected scripts sequentially in that order.

Name: sp_Blitz
Description: Diagnostic script: sp_Blitz.sql. The output query selects sp_Blitz's own output table column for column, in the order the script creates it (ID, ServerName, CheckDate, Priority, FindingsGroup, Finding, DatabaseName, URL, Details, QueryPlan, QueryPlanFiltered, CheckID), because the Export Pack reads this CSV and accepts that shape and no other. It used to select an xp_regread domain and an unaliased CONVERT of CheckDate instead, which is why every Export Pack built between 2026-07-23 and 2026-08-24 shipped without sp_Blitz. Change the column list or its order and the pack silently drops sp_Blitz again: Tests/SQLTriage.Tests/Portal/SpBlitzAppCsvContractTests is what turns that into a failed build. Dropping xp_regread also dropped the one sysadmin-only call on this path.
ExecutionTest:
IF OBJECT_ID('master.dbo.sqldba_sp_Blitz_output') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
	SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX([CheckDate]) FROM master.dbo.sqldba_sp_Blitz_output) > DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE()) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END [ToRun]
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SELECT 1 [ToRun]
END
SqlQueryForOutput: SELECT ID, ServerName, CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CheckDate, 120) AS CheckDate, Priority, FindingsGroup, Finding, DatabaseName, URL, Details, QueryPlan, QueryPlanFiltered, CheckID FROM master.dbo.sqldba_sp_Blitz_output WHERE CheckDate = (SELECT MAX([CheckDate]) FROM master.dbo.sqldba_sp_Blitz_output);

Name: sp_PerfCheck
Description: Diagnostic script: sp_PerfCheck 2.8 (version_date 20260801) by Erik Darling, Darling Data, LLC, MIT licensed, vendored unmodified from the DarlingData tag Updates_20260801. It has no @OutputTableName and writes nothing persistent (all 13 of its tables are #temp), so the EXEC lives in SqlQueryForOutput and the rows are read straight off the wire; there is no ExecutionTest because there is no output table whose freshness could be tested. It returns TWO result sets: a two-column Server Information banner first, then the nine-column findings (check_id, priority, priority_label, category, finding, database_name, object_name, details, url). OutputResultSetIndex 1 selects the findings; capturing set 0 would export the banner under this script's name. Zero findings is a healthy instance, not a failed export, which is what EmptyResultIsNormal tells the post-run modal. PERMISSIONS: sysadmin gives the complete audit. A login with VIEW SERVER STATE but not sysadmin still gets most of it: the script probes the permission for real by trying a DMV read, so the server-state checks still run. What drops out is the sysadmin-only work, chiefly the default trace, and the script reports that itself as check_id 5000 'Inadequate permissions' naming the GRANT it wants. Measured on SQL 2022 on 2026-08-24: 15 findings as sysadmin, run succeeded. The non-sysadmin number was NOT measured through a real login: that instance accepts Windows authentication only, so the probe ran under EXECUTE AS LOGIN impersonation of a VIEW SERVER STATE principal, where the run also succeeded and returned 4 findings. Impersonation additionally blocks reads of other databases unless the database is TRUSTWORTHY, so part of the drop from 15 to 4 is the probe and not the permission.

Name: SQLDBA.ORG.sp_triage
ExecutionTest:
IF OBJECT_ID('master.dbo.[sqldba_sp_triage®_output]') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
	SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(evaldate) AS evaldate FROM master.dbo.[sqldba_sp_triage®_output]) > DATEADD(DAY,-1,GETDATE()) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END [ToRun]
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SELECT 1 [ToRun]
END
SqlQueryForOutput:
SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT 
ID, evaldate, domain, SQLInstance, SectionID, Section, Summary, Severity, Details, HoursToResolveWithTesting, QueryPlan

FROM 
 (SELECT         CONVERT(NVARCHAR(25), T1.ID) AS ID, REPLACE(T1.evaldate, '~', '-') AS evaldate, REPLACE(T1.domain, '~', '-') AS domain, REPLACE(T1.SQLInstance, '~', '-') 
AS SQLInstance, REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), T1.SectionID), '~', '-') AS SectionID, REPLACE(T1.Section, '~', '-') AS Section, REPLACE(T1.Summary, '~', '-') AS Summary, 
 REPLACE(T1.Severity, '~', '-') AS Severity, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ISNULL(REPLACE(T1.Details, '~', '-'), N''), CHAR(9), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' '), ' ', ' ') AS Details, 
 REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), T1.HoursToResolveWithTesting), '~', '-') AS HoursToResolveWithTesting, REPLACE(T1.QueryPlan, '~', '-') AS QueryPlan, T1.ID AS Sorter
FROM            master.dbo.[sqldba_sp_triage®_output] AS T1 INNER JOIN
(SELECT        MAX(evaldate) AS evaldate
FROM            master.dbo.[sqldba_sp_triage®_output]) AS T2 ON T1.evaldate = T2.evaldate) AS T3
ORDER BY Sorter ASC
